name: Zeltplatz Falkencamp
beschreibung: The Falkencamp campsite is located in the municipality of Schwangau in the Allgäu, not far from the famous castles Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau. The site is situated in a natural environment on the edge of the village, with a view of the surrounding mountains of the Bayerischen Alpen. Guests can expect spacious pitches for tents and motorhomes, simple but clean infrastructure with sanitary facilities, as well as direct hiking and cycling trails into the surrounding area. The campsite is suitable for nature lovers and visitors who want to explore the region independently.
